name: Harvey
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Harvey is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, its investors, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Harvey is a privately held legal technology company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $550 million round announced on September 9, 2026, valued the company at $15.5 billion.

Founded in 2022 and based in San Francisco, Harvey develops AI software for legal work, which law firms and in-house legal teams use for research, drafting and the review of documents. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
table_note: Valuations are as announced by the company. Harvey has not used series names for its rounds since the Series E; the later labels follow the order of its rounds.
round_notes: In September 2026, Harvey said Teachers' Venture Growth, the late-stage investment platform of Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, had invested a further $50 million as an extension of the Series H, bringing the round to $600 million. With the Series F in December 2025, Harvey said it would complete its first tender offer.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Diffusion and Lightspeed Venture Partners co-led the Series H, GIC and Sequoia co-led the Series G, and Andreessen Horowitz led the Series F. Kleiner Perkins and Coatue co-led the Series E, Sequoia led the Series D and GV the Series C. Other investors include Conviction, Elad Gil, the OpenAI Startup Fund, EQT, Goldman Sachs Alternatives and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan.
spv_sentence: No special purpose vehicles naming Harvey appear in SEC Form D filings.
sources: Sources: Harvey announcements dated September 24, 2026, September 9, 2026, March 25, 2026, December 4, 2025, June 23, 2025, February 12, 2025 and July 23, 2024; TechCrunch reports dated September 9, 2026 and December 4, 2025; CNBC (May 2026); and SEC Form D filings.
